summary: Moved version display to settings for a cleaner interface.

items.text: Relocated version display to the settings page and removed the floating GitHub button for a streamlined user experience.

summary: Added multi-language support and improved changelog generation.

items.text: Introduced multi-language support for changelog generation to better serve diverse users.
Enabled user changelog storage with AI-assisted generation for enhanced changelog accuracy.
Implemented validation for API key usage to ensure proper functionality.

summary: Fixed permissions for release workflow to improve deployment reliability.

items.text: Updated release workflow permissions to allow issue and pull request management for smoother releases.

summary: Added public plaza and internationalization support with security and user experience enhancements.

items.text: Introduced a public plaza for community engagement and added support for multiple languages.
Merged security and user experience enhancements for a safer and more intuitive platform.

summary: Enhanced reliability and stability with improved error handling and testing.

items.text: Implemented advanced error boundaries and comprehensive testing to increase application stability.

summary: Added bilingual support and progressive web app features with data export and batch operations.

items.text: Enabled bilingual support for Chinese and English users.
Introduced progressive web app capabilities, data export options, and batch operation features for improved usability.

summary: Improved security with rate limiting and input validation, and resolved middleware conflicts.

items.text: Implemented rate limiting and input validation to enhance platform security.
Resolved conflicts in middleware to ensure smoother operation.

summary: Improved performance with database indexing and caching.

items.text: Added database indices and caching mechanisms to speed up data access and improve responsiveness.

summary: Set up automated testing frameworks for better quality assurance.

items.text: Established automated testing using modern frameworks to ensure software reliability.

summary: Fixed release process permissions to enable smoother deployments.

items.text: Added necessary permissions for pull requests in the release workflow to prevent deployment issues.

summary: Initial major release with core features including multi-user timelines, theme modes, and media management.

items.text: Launched personal life tracker with multi-user timelines and public plaza for community sharing.
Added light, dark, and system theme modes with easy switching for personalized appearance.
Introduced media management features including book import, music search, and entry editing with rich metadata.
Resolved various usability and compatibility issues to ensure smooth user experience.
Optimized sorting and search features for faster and more relevant results.
